baseline: YOLOv8m selected over YOLO11m; good image-level alarm but insufficient object recall and exact-class accuracy.
phase1: Mild mosaic and hierarchy were promising; balanced replay was rejected.
phase2: Optimized generic detector plus exact classifier improved sensitivity and class-aware F1 but reduced specificity.
phase3: Explicit Background_NotFO rejection restored validation specificity and remains the validated deployment configuration.
phase4: Finalized a three-stage architecture: Any-FM detector, binary FO/background verifier, and exact four-class classifier.
phase4b: Fine operating-point and rescue-gate refinement passed internal development but failed locked master validation; included here as engineering inference mode.
